title: Intrinsic labeled ordinary resolution associated to an embedded assignment
statement:
Fix a totally ordered set $L$ and a synchronized embedded assignment $E$ [def-trf-labeled-embedded-resolution]. A permitted embedding of a rational resolution input $S$ [def-trf-ordinary-resolution-rule] is an embedded pair $p=(X\hookrightarrow P)$ and an isomorphism $S\simeq X$ respecting the rational structure map. Let $\mathcal C$ be the subtype of inputs admitting such an embedding, with no embedding chosen in its membership predicate.

An intrinsic labeled ordinary tower over $S$ consists of an ordinary regular resolution tower $B$ [def-trf-ordinary-resolution-rule] with strictly increasing labels $\lambda:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\hookrightarrow L$, a diagram $D$ indexed contravariantly by lower cuts of $L$, and a monotone index $c(s)\in\{0,\ldots,n\}$ determined by $i<c(s)\iff\lambda(i)\in s$. Its bottom and top indices are $0,n$, and the index just before $\lambda(i)$ is $i$. Specified isomorphisms $D_s\simeq B_{c(s)}$ commute with every transition. The ideal $J_l$ on $D_{<l}$ is the transported ordinary center at $l=\lambda(i)$, and is the unit ideal at absent labels [def-nagata-extended-ideal]. Every $J_l$ is coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. Empty and regular inputs have length zero [def-weil-regular-scheme]. The map $D_s\to S$ is the stage isomorphism followed by the ordinary tower's structure map.

For $h:T\to S$, a contracted labeled pullback comparison is a natural transformation $D^T\to D^S$, cartesian over $h$ at every cut [def-pc-fibre-product], identifying all $J_l$ with extended ideals. Its labels are exactly the labels of $S$ whose extended ideals are nonunit, in their original order.

An identification with an embedding $p$ is an isomorphism $D\simeq E(p)^{\rm intrinsic}$ inducing the specified input isomorphism, identifying the active label sets and identifying each $J_l$ with the kernel ideal of the embedded center immersion into its strict transform. An intrinsic resolution assignment associated to $E$ consists of one such tower on every member of $\mathcal C$, these identifications for every embedding, satisfying the change-of-embedding cocycle using $E$'s intrinsic comparisons, and a unique contracted labeled pullback comparison for every smooth rational morphism between members of $\mathcal C$. For any cartesian smooth ambient square, the intrinsic comparison conjugated by the embedding identifications equals the supplied embedded comparison. These are structures and conditions, with no assertion here that they exist.
